title: Fun tour of Barcelona
text: Matthias was a very knowledgeable and personable guide full of information about the city!
author: DayTrip91706

title: An exceptional and unique opportunity to see Barcelona at its best
text:
This was an experience of a lifetime. I drove around with the Tour Guide on a
motorcycle which had an accompanying sidekick and we drove all around Barcelona at night and stopped at several locations for tapas. Our last visit was  to the top of Mount Montjuïc. The Guide had Champagne and we watched the city glow as we had a nice drink. We saw many sights of the city. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants something unique and your beautiful.
author: Laura_P

title: Pablo rocks!!
text: This was our favorite experience we had while in Barcelona. Pablo, our tour guide, was an expert historian and foodie. He loves motorcycles! He took care of us with  small details, like bringing nonalcoholic beverages for our hillside romantic view.   Pablo picked a small amazing gluten-free restaurant in his local neighborhood. It was a wonderful local experience.   He was an expert in gluten-free for my spouse! We will 100% use Brightside again and specifically request Pablo!
author: justinsZ9194NU

title: Don’t hesitate-book this tour!!
text: First day in Barcelona and best way to discover the whole city!!! Food stop way top notch, but the guidance and exposure to the city was the highlight of the evening. Spending the evening with Johannes was great as he was flexible to our requests and has great knowledge of the city!! Don’t hesitate to book this tour! For context we are a couple 60ish yrs old!!
author: Voyage605739

title: What a fun, unique way to see Barcelona.
text:
What a blast! A must-do when you’re in Barcelona. Our driver, Johannes,  was excellent. A great driver with very good knowledge of the city & its history. He made the journey really interesting & a lot of fun. 
The tapas were fab-u-lous! & the restaurant we went to was beautiful in a very quaint city neighborhood. 
We got to see so much of Barcelona that we would otherwise never have had the opportunity to experience. Definitely a very unique, fun way to see the city. 
Many thanks to Johannes for a one of a  kind, fun trip.
author: nancyg0502

title: An exhilarating road trip!
text: The motorcycle transport gave us a new and unique perspective of Barcelona. The tour’s itinerary was well explained at the beginning and end with a map. Along the way Johannes told us stories of each area as well as its history and significance today. The meal was a delicious sampling of Catalan food and highlighted with fun conversation.
author: Julia A

title: So much fun!
text: Book this! We had so much fun. Grandmas and kids alike loved this experience. The guides/drivers are so kind and knowledgeable, zooming us all around the city.  It’s super safe and so much fun!!
author: Lindsey_G

title: A Must-Do if Visiting Barcelona!
text: Highly recommend -a must-do if visiting Barcelona! And I bet ALL of their tours are just as awesome! We were staying in the Gothic Quarter and had to meet our fantastic guide, Stephan, just a little walk away--but it was easy to find the meeting point and he was right on time! Very friendly and informative, with lots of fun facts and knowledge about the city. Went up to Mt. Mounjuic to see the city from above along with a glass of cava, then visited major sites around the city and had a pit stop for some fantastic tapas and some more sights. author: kberge2019

title: Best Experience in Barcelona!
text: We spent the evening exploring Barcelona with Stephan.  He is a marvelous guide and we had a fantastic time.  It's such a unique and fun experience.  Stephan also allowed us to customize the tour to be able to experience Barcelona our own way.  For example, we had not seen Casa Batllo or Sagrada Familia at night so he made sure we did.  Book it now.  You won't regret it!
author: 557ronh

title: Amazing way to see Barcelona!
text: My husband and I had so much fun on this tour. Pablo is an excellent guide and great to hang out with. We got a perfect overview of the city on our first night, plus amazing views of the lighted fountains and overlooking the city. As an added bonus, the tapas and drinks were excellent, some of the best we had during our stay.
author: Frances_D
